# hoks

> Generative art by Joxemari Gallastegi (Donostia / San Francisco), published as
> hoks — "hand coded goods". Each family is a rule, not a picture: an algorithm
> plus a seed, a deterministic RNG, and a weighted palette. What you see is the
> residue of a system at work. No framework, no build step: the repository is
> the website.

Every published piece is reproducible. The same seed and the same sheet format
give the same image at any resolution, so the preview and the print are one file
apart, not one decision apart.

## Vocabulary

- **family** — a matrix of rules with its own name (PLLS, KRRTK, DTKRT, ECLPS,
  TRZS). Not a collection of images: the images are what the rules leave behind.
- **seed** — the integer that fixes one piece. `Rng` is an LCG, so seed → image
  is a function, not a lottery.
- **palette** — a named set of colours, chosen by weight at draw time. Recent
  palettes are likelier; retired ones stop appearing but keep their history.
- **format** — every piece exists square, vertical and horizontal (1:√2, DIN).
  Not a crop: the algorithm is given other dimensions and recomposes.
- **sheet** (*pliego*) — the paper it prints on: A4, A3, A2, A1 at 300 dpi.
- **rarity** — the combined improbability of one draw. It describes an edition,
  so it lives in the studio, not on the public pages.

## Machine-readable data

The site reads its own catalogue as JSON at runtime; those files are the same
surface for any reader. Served from the `main` branch.

- [works.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Joxemari/hoks/main/data/works.json): the family register — id, name, slug, `active`, year, trilingual description (eu/es/en), formats.
- [palettes.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Joxemari/hoks/main/data/palettes.json): every palette with its colours, tags and whether it is still in play.
- [site.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Joxemari/hoks/main/data/site.json): the artist statement, in Basque, Spanish and English.

## Works

- [PLLS](https://joxemari.github.io/hoks/plls.html) (2024): capsules given weather. A capsule is a distance between two points, given a thickness.
- [KRRTK](https://joxemari.github.io/hoks/krrtk.html) (2023): *Karratuak*. A square deciding, again and again, whether to divide.
- [DTKRT](https://joxemari.github.io/hoks/dtkrt.html) (2025): one lattice read twice — presence, then belonging.
- [ECLPS](https://joxemari.github.io/hoks/eclps.html): a single row of circles. The step never changes; the irregularity is all absence.
- [TRZS](https://joxemari.github.io/hoks/trzs.html): one ribbon crossing the frame until it meets what it already wrote.

## Essays

Written from the real code — every figure in them is rendered by the algorithm
it describes, not drawn for the occasion.

## Optional

- [About](https://joxemari.github.io/hoks/about.html): the statement.
- [Palettes](https://joxemari.github.io/hoks/palettes.html): the colour catalogue.

## Not for reading

`/admin.html`, `/sketches/`, `/_preview/`, `/impresion.html`, `/post.html` and
`/wall-studies.html` are the studio: generators, harnesses, print notes and
design artboards. They are in the repository because the repository is the
studio too, but they are not the work.
